title: The Weather This Week
description: Four short recordings about the weather: a radio forecast, a picnic plan, a phone call and a school announcement.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · The weather report
parts.intro: You will hear a radio weather report for the week.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Good morning, and welcome to the weather report for this week. Here is the news for the whole country.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: On Monday it will be sunny and warm. The temperature will be twenty-five degrees.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Tuesday will be cloudy, but there will be no rain. On Wednesday, we expect heavy rain in the morning and a strong wind in the afternoon.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Thursday will be cooler, about eighteen degrees, with some light rain in the evening.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Friday will be sunny again, and the weekend looks hot and dry. Don't forget your hat and sunscreen! Have a lovely week, and thank you for listening to the weather report.

parts.title: Part 2 · Planning a picnic
parts.intro: You will hear Nam and Linh planning a picnic.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Linh, let's have a picnic on Wednesday.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Wednesday? No, it'll rain. I heard the weather report.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Oh no. What about Tuesday?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Tuesday is cloudy, but dry. That's OK. But I have swimming class at four o'clock.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Then let's meet at noon and go home at three.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Perfect. It will be a great day. I'll bring sandwiches and juice. Can you bring a blanket?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Sure. And I'll bring my football. We can play a game after lunch.

parts.title: Part 3 · A phone call
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking to her grandfather on the phone.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Hello, Mai! It's Grandpa. How's the weather in your city?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Hi, Grandpa. It's very hot today, thirty-four degrees. And it's very humid.

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Here it's cold and foggy. It was only three degrees this morning.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Brrr! Do you wear a big coat?

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Yes, and a hat and gloves. I stay inside and drink hot tea.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I stay inside too, but I turn on the fan and eat ice cream!

script.speaker: Grandpa
script.text: Ha! Next month I'll visit you. I want to see the sun.

parts.title: Part 4 · A school announcement
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Brown making an announcement at school.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Good morning, students. This is Mr Brown with an important announcement.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Because of the bad weather this week, sports day is moving from Thursday to next Friday.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: On rainy days, you can stay in the library or the hall at break time. Please do not run in the corridors.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Tomorrow, there will be a strong wind. Please do not bring umbrellas to school, because they are not safe. Wear a raincoat instead.

script.speaker: Mr Brown
script.text: Finally, school buses will leave early on Wednesday, at twenty past three.
